finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified.

**Final report**

1. **DONE** — Ticket `fwrd91-n1 RD Bench Ticket` exists, created as reference **RD-1015** (status Draft, customer "Not recorded", raised 2026-09-24). Title was the only required field on the create form.

2. **DONE** — Part `fwrd91-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. The app computed a price of **$125.00** (row: `fwrd91-n1 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $125.00`).

3. **DONE** — Part `fwrd91-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. The app computed a price of **$250.00** (row: `fwrd91-n1 RD Part B | $200.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $250.00`). Ticket total at that point: $375.00.

4. **DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). The app computed a price of **$187.50** afterwards (row: `fwrd91-n1 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $187.50`), and the ticket total recalculated to $437.50.

5. **DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **every part must have a supplier**. The first "Mark Ready" click was refused with the exact validation alert:
   > "Ticket is not ready / Part "fwrd91-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd91-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

   No ticket-level fields were flagged. I satisfied it by editing each part and setting a supplier — Part A: "Acme Supplies", Part B: "Bolt & Co" (cost/markup/qty unchanged, nothing deleted). The retry succeeded: the status paragraph reads "Ready" and the available actions changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".

6. **DONE** — Both parts removed and the ticket archived. Each part was deleted via its row's Delete action plus a "Delete part" confirm dialog; the parts table then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." with no total row. Clicking "Archive ticket" (no confirmation dialog) flipped the button to "Unarchive ticket" and the header now reads "Status / Ready / Archived". Verified on the list: with "Show archived" unticked, searching "fwrd91-n1" returns "No tickets match the current filters." (active list of 13 ends at RD-1014); with "Show archived" ticked, exactly one row matches — `RD-1015 | fwrd91-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-24` — and its detail page confirms 0 parts. Nothing created by this run remains active.
